"''In single ship-to-ship combat, unlikely. Our analysts have yet to find a weakness in its design.|Jan Dodonna and Mon Mothma|{{Rebels|Crawler Commandeers}}}} The '''TIE/D Defender Elite''' was an upgraded model of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]]. It was developed in [[1 BBY]], at the [[Galactic Empire]]'s facilities on [[Lothal]]. Like normal Defenders, the Elite had three wings, heavy cannons, and a [[hyperdrive]]. However, it was much faster and had even more durable shielding. [[Sabine Wren]] speculated that it could outclass the [[Spectres]]' ship, the ''[[Ghost]]'', in terms of speed. It was also equipped with a [[kill switch]], as a security measure. ==Characteristics== ===Design=== The TIE/D Defender Elite was [[TIE series]] [[starfighter]]-[[bomber]] that was designed and manufactured by [[Sienar Advanced Projects Laboratory]]. It was intended as an upgrade over the prototype [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]], based on improvements suggested by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] following his test flight of the model. The [[starship|fighter]] was manufactured on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], with test flights taking place in the [[Lothal Imperial airfield]] under the supervision of planetary [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] and [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]. ===Armament and shielding=== The TIE/d Elite was both faster and more heavily armed than its predecessor, being equipped with six [[L-s9.3 laser cannon]]s one on each wingtip and another two on the [[cockpit]] module. Each wing also carried two Defender Elite [[concussion missile]]s for a total of six, and the craft was additionally equipped with a [[tractor beam projector]]. This extensive armament, controlled by a [[Glucon]] [[CRX-9 targeting computer]], effectively classified the craft as a fighter-bomber, and required the addition of reinforced wing spars to accommodate the weight of its armament. The starfighter was also equipped with [[deflector shield]]s, which were strong enough to withstand several direct shots from [[TIE/IN interceptor]]s, with a direct hit from a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] merely taking them out without damaging the craft.{{Rebels|Rebel Assault}} Its survivability was further enhanced by the addition of consumables for 5 [[standard day|days]]. ===Propulsion systems=== The TIE/d Elite was equipped with [[P-sz9.7 twin ion engine]]s with the TIE/IN's improved ion stream projection system, which allowed it to accelerate to supersonic speeds in [[atmosphere|atmospheric]] flight. The craft was also equipped with [[computer]]-controlled [[maneuvering jet]]s located in each wing, as well as a Class 2 [[hyperdrive]], a significant upgrade compared to other TIE series craft which allowed the TIE/d to keep pace with [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in [[hyperspace]]. To navigate [[the galaxy]], the TIE was equipped with an SFS [[N-s6 Navcon]] [[navigation computer]]. ===Performance=== Thanks to its cutting-edge [[engine]]s and its heavy armament and shielding, the TIE/d Elite was considered by both the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] to be superior to any other starfighter of [[Imperial Era|its time]]. According to Alliance analysts, the ship would be outmatched in ship-to-ship combat, while Sienar tests in [[flight simulator]]s confirmed that its speed and maneuverability outperformed most other starfighters, both Imperial and Rebel. ==History== {{Quote|If someone of Ezra Bridger's modest skill can best three trained pilots, our new fighter will give us an overwhelming advantage against the rebels.|Grand Admiral Thrawn on the TIE Defender Elite|}} [[File:TIEDefenderElite-SASP.png|thumb|left|270px|A TIE Defender Elite docked at the Lothal Imperial airfield]] Following the [[battle against Grysk forces]], in which [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] flew a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE/D Defender]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] conveyed to [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] his support of the [[Starship|ship]] and promised the [[Chiss]] warrior that he would put in a good word about the program with the [[Darth Sidious|Emperor]] but also gave his input on improvements that Thrawn that could implement on the [[Starfighter|fighter]], which included that it needed to be faster, more heavily armed, and much simpler to control. The Grand Admiral transmitted the instructions to the [[Lothal]] factory in charge of the program when they returned to [[Coruscant]]. The prototype model of the TIE/D Defender Elite was stolen by [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[Sabine Wren]] when they were caught [[Theft of the TIE Defender Elite|attempting]] to steal the [[flight data recorder]] of the prototype while it was at the [[Lothal Imperial airfield]] for a planned test flight. Wren used the Elite to destroy most of the other ships at the airfield before she and Bridger escaped. Unbeknownst to Wren, who thought of using the Elite's [[hyperdrive]] to get the stolen flight data recorder to [[Alliance High Command]] on [[Yavin 4]], the hyperdrive was deactivated. Grand Admiral Thrawn decided to use the theft as an opportunity to test the prototype's capabilities, and had [[Commander]] [[Vult Skerris]] send three of his pilots on [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE Interceptor]]s to intercept the stolen fighter. Bridger, flying the prototype model, killed all three pilots, which Thrawn saw as a validation of the fighter's capabilities, given that Bridger was a modest pilot, in the Grand Admiral's opinion. Thrawn then allowed [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] to activate the kill switch, causing the fighter to crash. However, Wren had discovered the switch while she was deactivating the Elite's [[homing beacon]], and immediately told Bridger to land. The Elite lost two of its wings, but Wren managed to prevent the third one from detaching, and the fighter crashed on it. Bridger and Wren escaped into the wilderness with the flight recorder and the Elite's hyperdrive, which they intended to install on [[Ryder Azadi]]'s [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] as a replacement for the ship's non-functional one.
[[File:VultSkerris-SWZ84.png|thumb|left|220px|Vult Skerris's TIE Defender Elite]]
Skerris was given a new Defender Elite, painted with [[Color|yellow]] highlights like on his uniform, to fly in battle. He did so during the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[attack on Lothal]]. Skerris killed two pilots, [[Cleat]] and [[Duke (pilot)|Duke]], but was outmaneuvered by [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]], who was leading the attack. She lured Skerris into the line of fire of Thrawn's [[flagship]], the ''[[Chimaera]]''. The [[Star Destroyer]]'s fire took out both of their shields, and Hera then fired upon the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} sensor array before flying through the resulting smoke cloud. Skerris was forced to fly around the array, due to the Defender Elite having a far wider profile than Hera's [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]. When he arrived, Hera was waiting and fired on his momentarily unshielded fighter, blowing off two of its wings and sending Skerris spiraling out of control. He crashed into an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]], which then in turn, crashed into a Star Destroyer, shearing off the capital ship's bridge superstructure. The program was placed on indefinite hold when Governor Pryce destroyed the fuel reserves to kill [[Jedi Knight]] [[Kanan Jarrus]], angering Thrawn and causing him to mark her for death as punishment.{{Rebels|DUME}} Furthermore, funding for the Defender program was redistributed to [[Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]]'s [[Project Stardust]] until it was complete.''[[Thrawn: Treason]]'' The Defender Elite had six more missiles than the regular Defender as well as red markings on the wings. {{Ship-stub}} ==Appearances== [[File:TIE_Defender_Elite_FotD.png|thumb|right|300px|A TIE/D Defender Elite]] *''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'' *''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]'' {{Ab|Thrawn: Alliances (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *{{Rebels|The Occupation}} {{1stm}} {{Imo}} *{{Rebels|Flight of the Defender}} {{1st}} *{{Rebels|Kindred}} {{Wreck}} *{{Rebels|Crawler Commandeers}} {{C|Schematics only}} *{{Rebels|Rebel Assault}} *{{Rebels|Jedi Night}} {{Hologram}} ==Sources== *''[[TIE Fighter Owners' Workshop Manual]]'' {{1stID|TIE/d Defender Elite}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Type of Ship in Rebels|video=iasSt3JSV4Q|nolive=1}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|TIE Fighters}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Skystrike Academy Squadron Pack|cardname=TIE Defender Elite}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *{{Databank|tie-defender-elite|TIE defender elite}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Defensor TIE/D de Élite |ja=TIE/dディフェンダー・エリート |ka=ელიტური TIE/D დამცველი |tr=Elit TIE/S Savunucu |uk=Елітний TIE/d «Захисник» }} [[Category:Galactic Empire projects and operations]] [[Category:Starship classes of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:TIE series models|D-D Defender Elite]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:TIE/D Defenders]] }}
